intro: The plan was perfect, which is why nobody wrote it down. Instead, each member of the crew hid their part of it somewhere only the others would think to look. Overnight the place changes personality: the slots are loud at noon, then the pit goes quiet as a church while the same four players nurse one drink each and watch the clocks. The glass on the high-limit tables gets wiped in circular strokes, and by morning there is always the same faint smudge in the same corner, as though somebody has leaned there a little longer than they meant to. We treat it like a signature and leave it alone; the pit boss says a clean window would only attract questions. Nobody mentions the footprints in the carpet near the staff door, and nobody needs to.
echo: The architect gave the strongroom an arched ceiling, as if it were a cathedral.
